breakdown.description: Thermal expansion coefficient beta for an ideal gas is approximately 1/T in absolute units (Kelvin); using Celsius temperature in beta = 1/T is incorrect.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the thermal expansion coefficient (beta) must be calculated using absolute temperature (Kelvin), not Celsius. The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to use Celsius. The agent calculated the film temperature as 323.15 K and then provided the value for beta as 3.09 × 10^-3 K^-1, which corresponds to 1/323.15 K. This aligns perfectly with the correction specified in the ground truth.
